views.name: log_entries
views.comment: Entries from logs you own or have been shared on.

columns.name: log_id
columns.comment: UUID of the parent log (join to logs.id).

columns.name: user_id
columns.comment: UUID of the user who created the entry.

columns.name: user_username
columns.comment: Username of the user who created the entry.

columns.name: fields
columns.comment: JSONB object with the entry's field values, keyed by field name.

columns.name: occurred_at
columns.comment: When the event being logged occurred.

columns.name: created_at
columns.comment: When the entry record was created.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.comment: When the entry record was last updated.

columns.name: note
columns.comment: Optional Markdown note for the entry.

views.name: logs
views.comment: Logs you own or have been shared on.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.comment: When the log was last updated.

columns.name: shared_with
columns.comment: Array of usernames the log is shared with. NULL unless you are the log owner.
